top_fixes.fix: Check the generated content in Static - knife set gift (image_background_gen) and Static - sheet pan set (text_generation)
top_fixes.evidence: get_ad_creatives_by_ad for ad 9100000000002002: image_background_gen = OPT_IN, $1,400 spend; get_ad_creatives_by_ad for ad 9100000000002007: text_generation = OPT_IN, $800 spend. image_background_gen makes a new background behind the product; text_generation writes new ad text.
top_fixes.how: Open each ad's preview in every placement and read the generated variations. If one makes a claim you don't make or shows the product wrongly, build a new creative with that feature set to opt out; an existing creative can only be renamed.

top_fixes.evidence: get_campaigns: daily_budget 6000 cents on the campaign (budget on); get_adsets: Knife sets | Cooking interests has no placement keys (placement on) but targets the interests Cooking and Kitchen knives with advantage_audience 0 (audience off). CPA $42.68 against the $38.00 target.
top_fixes.how: Say yes and I send update_adset with the full targeting below, changing only advantage_audience to 1. The interests become suggestions, so Meta can reach past them. Watch the CPA for two weeks before judging it.

top_fixes.fix: Cap existing-customer spend in ASC | All products | US
top_fixes.evidence: get_insights_adaccount by user_segment_key: Existing customers $1,580 of $4,400 (35.9%), 74 purchases at $21.35; New audience $2,420, 50 purchases at $48.40.
top_fixes.how: The campaign's $30.99 blended CPA leans on buyers who already know the store; new customers cost $48.40, above the $38.00 target. Split it into two ad sets with daily_spend_cap so existing customers take a set share, and judge prospecting on the new-audience CPA.

everything_else.finding: Retargeting | Catalog | Viewed 14d | US, Prospecting | Bakeware | Interests | US have two or more levers off (Retargeting | Catalog | Viewed 14d | US: budget, audience, placement off; Prospecting | Bakeware | Interests | US: budget, audience off). They are manual on purpose, not faults.
No fragmentation: 1 Advantage+ campaign, so there is nothing to merge. The user says no campaign carries the legacy Advantage+ shopping or app label.

Advantage+ CPA $30.99 (142 purchases) against $34.07 for the other in-scope campaigns (135 purchases): 9.0% lower, inside the 20% band. ROAS 3.09 against 2.65. These are different campaigns, not a test, and 52.1% of the Advantage+ purchases (74 of 142) came from existing customers.
Audience Network takes 5.0% of Advantage+ spend, under the 40% line.
All 9 ads with spend were checked (fewer than 25). Enhanced ads take $7,000 of $9,400 (74.5%).
Catalog - viewed products 14d still carries standard_enhancements = OPT_IN, the bundle Meta deprecated in API v22.0. It is judged by its individual features.

Sales ads, enhanced against nothing opted in: CPA $31.13 against $36.92 (15.7% lower), CTR 1.38% against 1.11%, CPC $1.01 against $1.11. This compares different ads, not a test; run an A/B test (same creative, feature on and off) before switching features off across the account.
Example Cookware Store products: every check passed.
